messages:
elaine: Heads-up — after the RBAC cleanup earlier this morning we're seeing the SAST pipeline fail on decrypt during evidence bundling. Not sure if scanner SA lost keystore access.
security-oncall: thanks, filing as incident-ish. can you paste the CI error?
elaine: here —
```
Error: kms:Decrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01: AccessDenied
at s3://redwood-artifacts/.../evidence.tar.gz
```
ryan-dev: looks like the scanner service account lost kms:Decrypt on the key alias. we rotated a role binding in infra-rbac earlier that removed an old arn.
sec-bot: alert: change detected by keystore-audit (change_id=chg-2026-03-21-089). linked PR: https://git.company/pr/8543 :warning:
jordan: is this blocking deploys or just nightly scans?
elaine: blocking the nightly gating job (merge checks). deploys are fine for now but merges might be blocked if we don't triage quick.
marta: quick workaround is to give the scanner SA an ephemeral grant during CI or re-add Decrypt permission to the role. which is preferable?
ryan-dev: ephemeral grant is ideal long-term (least privilege). short-term we might re-grant to unblock merges. I'll open a PR to re-add kms:Decrypt to role redwood-scanner-role for the specific key alias.
alex: pls include audit log correlation in the PR: we need the request-id from the denied event to confirm it was the RBAC change and to update the keystore runbook.
elaine: I pulled the CloudTrail entry: requestID = 9f8b7c6d-0a2e-4f3c-bb9d-77a1c2e3d4f5. It shows principal arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-scanner-role/session.
security-oncall: good. two action items: (1) ryan — PR to re-grant decrypt with scoped resource and a review by eng-sre; (2) infra — design ephemeral grant flow for CI that logs issuance events to audit stream.
ryan-dev: opening PR now. adding reviewers @eng-sre and @security-oncall. PR description includes remediation steps and tests to ensure scanner can decrypt in the staging pipeline.
marta: for ephemeral approach we can use KMS Grant API during job startup + write grant ID to artifact metadata so audit tools can stitch it. note: grants expire or must be retired; add a garbage-collect step.
jordan: also add a fallback in the SAST runner: if Decrypt fails, attach the error payload to the ticket and mark as "evidence-missing" not "pass/fail" so we don't silently allow insecure merges.
elaine: agreed. I'll update triage playbook to: "if evidence decrypt fails, create incident with CloudTrail requestID, attach CI log, and label PR as blocked."
sec-bot: suggestion: add an automated guard in infra-pr-bot to detect role changes that remove kms:Decrypt from scanner role and tag it as security-sensitive.
alex: one more ask — after we regrant, run a quick full-scan on a test branch and attach the artifact to this thread so QA can confirm no findings lost.
ryan-dev: PR created: https://git.company/pr/8601 — includes scoped kms:Decrypt, audit notes, and a short-lived regrant timeline. kicking off the staging pipeline now.
elaine: staging run passed after regrant. evidence artifact decrypted successfully. marking as mitigated for now, moving ephemeral grant design to infra backlog. :thumbsup:
security-oncall: closing loop: update runbook entry #sdlc-keystore and add a checklist: pre-PR rbac impact review, CI ephemeral grant plan, audit correlation steps. thanks all.
